module: Flowgraph node "Get Signal Controller" (repeat_instant). Reads a traffic light controller (signalControllerData): signalType, stateCount, duration (totalDuration) and, for each state i (adjustable count), stateName_i and stateDuration_i ('none' and 0 if absent).

_onDeserialized.desc: Restores the node's own settings from the saved data.

_onSerialize.desc: Adds the node's own settings to the `res` table when saving the graph.

drawCustomProperties.desc: Draws the node's custom properties in the flowgraph editor panel (ImGui).

init.desc: Initializes the node's internal state at creation (called by the flowgraph engine).

postInit.desc: Called after the node's pins are created; used to adjust the pins (value templates, file filters, dynamic keys).

updatePins.desc: Adds or removes the stateName_i / stateDuration_i pins and deletes their links.

work.desc: Copies type, state count, total duration and the name/duration of each state to the outputs.
